question: The function $f(x)$ is defined and twice differentiable for all $x \in \mathbb{R}$ and has critical points at $x = -1$ and $x = 2$. If $f'(x)$ changes sign from positive to negative at $x = -1$ and from negative to positive at $x = 2$, which of the following statements is TRUE?

options.A: $f(x)$ has a local minimum at $x = -1$ and a local maximum at $x = 2$
options.B: $f(x)$ has a local maximum at $x = -1$ and a local minimum at $x = 2$
options.C: $f(x)$ has local maxima at both $x = -1$ and $x = 2$
options.D: $f(x)$ has local minima at both $x = -1$ and $x = 2$
